units.rawText: Hm? Why do I call you my comrade? Is that not obvious?
units.displayText: Hm? Why do I call you my comrade? Is that not obvious?

spans.text: Hm? Why do I call you my comrade? Is that not obvious?

units.rawText: We once fought side by side in another world, and here... You are my accomplice in fooling the world. This is a bond beyond acquaintances or friends... and so the only word for someone who has surpassed those definitions is "my comrade".
